name: Coral bleaching
summary: No global bleaching event since June; El Niño heat stress building
state: The fourth global coral bleaching event was declared over in June 2026. Heat stress has built across the northern Caribbean, with a basin-wide alert level 1 forecast by November (GCRMN), and scientists warn the El Niño could bring a fifth global event; no new regional mass bleaching was confirmed as of 3 Nov.
rubric_hit: No global or major regional bleaching event

sources.title: GCRMN — Heat stress builds across the northern Caribbean
CORDAP — Will El Niño bring a fifth global bleaching event?

why: Reefs support a quarter of marine species and coastal economies; mass bleaching is a direct sign of ocean heat stress.
drivers: Marine heatwaves, El Niño, warming trend.

rubric.alert: Bleaching extent at record levels with active new alerts in the past month.
rubric.watch: Global bleaching event in progress, or regional mass bleaching.
rubric.normal: No global bleaching event in progress.
